headline: BREAKING: First Hospital Opens on the Moon
body: Lunar Health Corp announced the grand opening of 'Selene General Hospital' on the Moon's south pole. The facility reportedly offers free surgeries and zero-gravity physical therapy to all citizens.
hint: No hospital has ever been built on the Moon. This is an obvious fabrication.

headline: Apollo 11 Moon Landing — July 20, 1969
body: On July 20, 1969, NASA astronauts Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin became the first humans to walk on the Moon as part of the Apollo 11 mission. The event was broadcast live to an estimated 600 million viewers worldwide.
hint: This is a well-documented historical event. The facts check out.

headline: Scientists Confirm: Earth's Oceans Are Rising at Record Pace
body: A consortium of international climate researchers has released data confirming that global sea levels rose by 4.6mm in the past year, the fastest rate recorded in the satellite era.
